note: families: keyed by '<kingdom>/<slug>'; null means GBIF had no confident FAMILY match for that name. matchType 'LOCAL_CACHE' means familyKey came from an existing gbif-cache-<class>.json rather than a live call, with the ancestor keys filled in from orderGroups. orderGroups: keyed by '<kingdom>/<order-dir>', one live ORDER-rank call shared across every LOCAL_CACHE family in that order.
source: GBIF species API, GET /v1/species/match?name=...&rank=FAMILY (or ORDER, for families whose familyKey came from the local per-class caches instead)
